properties.name: lilo.graphQlPath
properties.description: GraphQL path which serves query and mutation operations.

properties.name: lilo.subscriptionPath
properties.description: GraphQL subscription path the WebSocket handler is bound to. When it equals the GraphQL path, websocket upgrade requests on that path are routed to the subscription handler.

properties.name: lilo.allowed-origins
properties.description: Origin patterns the subscription WebSocket endpoint accepts, such as https://app.example.com or https://*.example.com. The default, *, accepts every origin; an empty list accepts same-origin requests only.

properties.name: lilo.send-time-limit
properties.description: How long a send to a subscription client may take before its session is closed as not reliable. Checked only when another frame is sent to the client while a send is in progress; the container's own blocking send timeout remains the backstop for the thread that is writing.

properties.name: lilo.send-buffer-size-limit
properties.description: How many bytes may wait to be sent to a subscription client before its session is closed as not reliable. Checked only when another frame is sent to the client while a send is in progress.

properties.name: lilo.subscription-pool-size
properties.description: Core size of the pool that stitches subscriptions. The pool grows to four times that and queues up to 256 more requests; a subscribe beyond that is answered with an error message. If not set, it's max(4, available processors).

properties.name: lilo.max-operations-per-session
properties.description: How many operations one subscription client session may have at the same time. A subscribe beyond that is answered with an error message and the session stays open.
